y-m-19-12.title: Isho ‘2x+1/3’ izofundwa kanjani efasiteleni lengxoxo?
y-m-19-12.goal: Qinisekisa ukuthi amabhulakithi anquma ukulandelana kokubala ekubhalweni kwezisho ezinokuguquguquka, futhi uphinde ubhale isisho emyalezweni ukuze umfundi angaphutheki.
y-m-19-12.material: Efasiteleni lengxoxo awukwazi ukubhala ingxenyana enebha evundlile, ngakho / isetshenziselwa ukubonisa ukuhlukanisa. USeoyeon wathumela umngani lo myalezo: "Indawo ingu-2x+1/3." Kwezibalo, ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa kubalwa ngaphambi kokungeza, futhi u-2x ngumkhiqizo wo-2 no-x. (U-2x ufundwa 'two x'.)
y-m-19-12.thinking.0: Nquma ukuthi izinhlamvu ezifanayo zifundwa njengezisho ezihlukile yini
y-m-19-12.thinking.1: Hlola ukuthi inani lishintsha kangakanani kuye ngokuthi lifundwa kanjani
y-m-19-12.prereq.0: Ukubhalwa kokuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa ezishweni ezinokuguquguquka (u-2x ungu-2×x, u-a÷b ungu-a/b)
y-m-19-12.s.s1.prompt: Uma u-x=4, inani lesisho esithi '2x+1/3' emyalezweni lingakanani uma ulibala ngemithetho yezibalo?
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.0: Esishweni emyalezweni, qala uthole ukubala okungeyona ukungeza (ukuphindaphinda, ukuhlukanisa) futhi ukumake.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza ukubala okumakiwe, bese wenza ukungeza okusele ekugcineni.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.a: Ubale u-2x=8 kuqala bese wengeza u-1/3. Ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa kuza ngaphambi kokungeza.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.b: Awekho amabhulakithi, nokho wengeze u-x no-1 kuqala. U-2x ubalwa kuqala njengo-2×4.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.c: Wenze ukungeza kuqala bese uhlukanisa ngo-3. Ukuhlukanisa kunamathela engxenyeni u-1/3 kuphela.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.o.d: Umuntu ngamunye owutholayo angawufunda ngokuhlukile, ngakho inani alikwazi ukunqunywa libe elilodwa
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.d: Ukukhathazeka ukuthi umuntu ongazi imithetho angawufunda ngokuhlukile kunobulungisa. Noma kunjalo, uma usebenzisa imithetho, inani liyanqunywa.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.explain: U-2x ungu-2×4=8, futhi u-1/3 ungukuhlukanisa ngakho ubalwa ngaphambi kokungeza. 8 + 1/3 = 25/3.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.acc.0: Ngemithetho kunqunywa ukuthi ungu-25/3, kodwa ukukhathazeka ukuthi abanye abafundi bangakhumbula imithetho ngokuhlukile kunengqondo. Esinyathelweni esilandelayo, cabanga ukuthi ungakunciphisa kanjani lokhu kukhathazeka.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.prompt: Kunezindlela ezimbili zokuwufunda. (가) Ukufunda ngemithetho: inani lika-2x kanye no-1/3. (나) Ukufunda kabi: inani lika-(2x+1) elihlukaniswe ngo-3. Uma ufaka inombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12 esikhundleni sika-x, thola u-x abathathu ahlukile lapho umehluko phakathi kwamanani okufunda okubili ungu-7 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ambalwa, njengo-x=2, 6, bala amanani ka-(가) no-(나) kokunye ngakunye, futhi uwabhale ethebuleni.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ethebuleni, bheka ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwamanani amabili ushintsha kanjani njengoba u-x ekhula.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Iyinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala u-x njengenombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Umehluko phakathi kwamanani okufunda okubili ungu-7 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c2: Umehluko phakathi kwamanani okufunda okubili ungaphansi kuka-7. Bala amanani amabili futhi uthole umehluko.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.explain: (가)−(나) = (2x+1/3) − (2x+1)/3 = 4x/3, ngakho ukuze umehluko ube ngu-7 noma ngaphezulu, u-x kumele abe ngu-6 noma ngaphezulu. Uma u-x=6, u-(가) ungu-12 no-1/3 futhi u-(나) ungu-4 no-1/3, ngakho umehluko ungu-8. Uma u-x ekhula, umehluko uyakhula.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.prompt: Uma uSeoyeon efuna ukusho inani lika-(2x+1) elihlukaniswe ngo-3, kufanele libhalwe kanjani emgqeni owodwa usebenzisa izinhlamvu zekhibhodi kuphela efasiteleni lengxoxo ukuze kungabikho ukungaqondi? Bhala isisho futhi uchaze emshweni owodwa ukuthi kungani ubhale kanjalo.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi lokho okuhlukaniswa ngo-3 yi-2x kuphela noma yonke i-2x+1.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.1: Faka u-x=4 esishweni osibhalile futhi uhlole ukuthi inani elibaliwe lilona ofuna (3).
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uhlole ngokufaka izinombolo esikhundleni sika-x ukuthi isisho osibhalile, uma sifundwa ngemithetho, sinika inani lika-(2x+1) elihlukaniswe ngo-3?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ucabange ukuthi umngani wakho uzowufunda kanjani futhi wanciphisa izindawo zokungaqondi?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ucabange nangezindlela zokwenza kube lula ukufunda, njengokusebenzisa uphawu lokuphindaphinda (*)?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.0: Ngizobhala (2x+1)/3. Ukubeka u-2x+1 emabhulakitheni kucacisa ukuthi lonke lihlukaniswa ngo-3 ngasikhathi sinye, ngakho akekho oyofunda ngokuhlukile.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.1: Libhale njenge-(2*x+1)/3 futhi ubeke amabhulakithi ukuze ukulandelana kokubala kungaqondwa kabi. Sebenzisa nophawu lokuphindaphinda * ukucacisa ukuthi u-2 no-x bahlukile.

y-m-19-06.title: Uma izinga lokushisa lihluka nge-7℃, yini enye esidinga ukuyazi?

y-m-19-06.material: Ngolunye usuku, izinga lokushisa ngo-9 ekuseni lalingu-−3℃ (amadigri angu-3 ngaphansi kuka-zero). Kuthiwa izinga lokushisa ngo-3 ntambama lalihluke ngo-7℃ kwelika-9 ekuseni. Wonke amazinga okushisa anikezwa njengezinombolo ezigcwele (℃). Vumela izinga lokushisa lika-3 ntambama libe ngu-t℃, futhi umehluko ungowokukhulu kwezimbili kususwe okuncane.

y-m-19-06.s.s1.hint.0: Maka u-−3 emugqeni wezinombolo bese ubala ukuthi mangaki amaphoyinti angu-7 amagxathu ukusuka kuyo.
y-m-19-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ngqo umehluko (omkhulu kususwe omncane) phakathi kwenani olithole no-−3.
y-m-19-06.s.s1.fail.c2: Umehluko no-−3℃ awuyona i-7℃. Hlola izindawo ezingu-7 amagxathu ukusuka ku-−3 emugqeni wezinombolo.

y-m-19-06.s.s2.prompt: Yini enye ongadinga ukuyazi ukunquma izinga lokushisa lika-3 ntambama libe yinani elilodwa? Khetha konke okungalinquma uma ukwazi okukodwa kuphela.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi ongakutshela ukuthi liyiphi kwamabili amanani owathole esinyathelweni esedlule.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola: 'Uma ngazi lolu lwazi, ngingakwazi yini ukwehlukanisa u-4 no-−10?'
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.a: Inani eliqondile lamahora adlule phakathi kwezikhathi ezimbili
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.a: Ukuthi kudlule isikhathi esingakanani akukutsheli ukuthi izinga lokushisa likhuphukile noma lehlile.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.b: Ukuthi ngo-3 ntambama bekufudumele noma kubanda kunangu-9 ekuseni
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.b: Lolu ulwazi olunquma ukuthi uye kwesokunene noma kwesobunxele kusuka ku-−3. Lunquma elilodwa kwamabili.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.c: Ukuthi izinga lokushisa lika-3 ntambama liphezulu noma liphansi kuno-0℃ (zero degrees)
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.c: U-4℃ uphezulu kuno-0℃ futhi u-−10℃ uphansi, ngakho lolu lwazi lwehlukanisa nokubili.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.d: Inani elihlolwe kabusha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinga lokushisa lika-9 ekuseni lalingu-−3℃ ngempela
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.d: Ukuthi inani elinikeziwe lilungile yini akunalo ubudlelwano nesizathu sokuthi inani lihlukane abe ngamabili kule nkinga.

y-m-19-04.title: Ukuthola inombolo okufanele iphindaphindwe ngayo u-72 ukuthola isikwele senombolo ethile
y-m-19-04.topic: Ukuphindaphinda ukwenza inombolo eyisikwele (inani lezici eziyinhloko)
y-m-19-04.goal: Thola hhayi eyodwa kuphela kodwa izinombolo eziningana ezenza inombolo eyisikwele uma ziphindaphindwa, bese uchaza ngamagama umthetho zonke ezabelana ngawo.
y-m-19-04.material: Sifuna ukuphindaphinda u-72 ngenombolo yemvelo a ukuze umkhiqizo ube yisikwele senombolo yemvelo ethile (inombolo eyenziwe ngokuphindaphinda inombolo efanayo kabili). Isibonelo, kufana nokuphindaphinda u-12 ngo-3 ukuthola 12×3 = 36 = 6×6. Cabanga kuphela ngo-a njengenombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-100.
y-m-19-04.thinking.1: Thola umthetho ovamile phakathi kwezixazululo eziningana
y-m-19-04.thinking.2: Chaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwesixazululo esincane kakhulu nezinye
y-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu a eyenza inombolo yesikwele uma iphindaphindwa ngo-72?
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo zesikwele eziseduze no-72, 64 no-81, bese uhlola ukuthi u-72 uyinombolo yesikwele yini.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala u-72 njengomphumela wezinombolo ezimbili, 8×9, bese ubheka ukuthi yiphi kuzo esivele iyisikwele senye inombolo.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.a: Kufanele uqale uhlole ukuthi u-72 uqobo uyinombolo yesikwele yini. U-72 uphakathi kuka-8×8=64 no-9×9=81, ngakho akayona inombolo yesikwele.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.b: Ku-72=2×2×2×3×3, ama-3 ayalingana ngamapheya, futhi kusala u-2 oyedwa. Uma uphindaphinda ngo-2 owodwa omunye, ube nefomu lapho konke kuhlanganiswe ngamapheya.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.c: 72×3=216. Uphakathi kuka-14×14=196 no-15×15=225, ngakho akayona inombolo yesikwele. Ukuphindaphinda ngo-3 kwenza ama-3 amathathu, okubhubhisa ukuhlanganiswa ngamapheya.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.d: 72×8=576=24×24, ngakho kuliqiniso ukuthi iba inombolo yesikwele. Kodwa awuhlolanga ukuthi ingabe kukhona nenombolo encane esebenza yini.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Uma ubhala u-72 njengo-2×2×2×3×3, ama-3 ayalingana ngamapheya futhi kusala u-2 oyedwa. Ukuphindaphinda ngo-2 kunika 2×2×2×2×3×3 = (2×2×3)×(2×2×3) = 12×12. U-1 awusebenzi, ngakho inombolo encane kakhulu ngu-2.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola izinombolo a ezintathu ezihlukile ezenza inombolo yesikwele uma ziphindaphindwa ngo-72. (Izinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-100)
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngenombolo encane kakhulu, u-2, bese uhlola ukuthi ukuphindaphinda u-2 ngenye inombolo kuqhubeka yini nokunika izinombolo zesikwele.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umphumela ngamunye owenzile njengomphumela wezinombolo ezimbili ezifanayo ukuze uhlole.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a yinombolo esuka ku-1 kuya ku-100.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Inani eliphindaphindwe no-72 aliyona isikwele senombolo yemvelo ephi. Thola umphumela bese uhlola ukuthi ungabhalwa yini njengomphumela wezinombolo ezimbili ezilinganayo.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.explain: 2, 8, 18, 32, 50, 72, 98 zonke ziyasebenza. Isibonelo, 72×18 = 1296 = 36×36. Zikhona eziyisikhombisa sonke ezingu-100 noma ngaphansi.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Uma uhlela ama-a owathole kusukela encane kakhulu, yiliphi iphethini elivamile olibonayo? Bhala umthetho ngamazwi akho.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-a ngamunye owuthole njengo-2×(inombolo ethile) bese ubeka izinombolo ezisebakaki eceleni komunye nomunye.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlela izinombolo ezivele ebakaki kusukela encane kakhulu, bese ubhala inombolo ngayinye njengokuphindaphinda.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole ukuthi umthetho owubhalile usebenza nakuma-a owungawathola (isb., 72, 98)?

y-m-19-04.s.s3.model.0: a ngu-2, 8, 18, 32, 50, futhi zonke zingu-2 izikhathi inombolo yesikwele njengo-1, 4, 9, 16, 25. Ngakho uma ziphindaphindwa no-72, kuvela u-2 owodwa omunye, izinto ziyalingana ngamapheya, futhi iba inombolo yesikwele.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.model.1: U-72 yinombolo eyenziwe ngokuphindaphinda u-2 kathathu no-3 kabili. U-2 oyedwa uyasala, ngakho a kufanele afake u-2 oyedwa omunye, bese ungaphindaphinda nganoma yiyiphi inombolo kabili. Ngakho uthola 2, 2×2×2=8, 2×3×3=18.

y-m-19-03.title: Ukudonsa amakhadi amathathu amkhiqizo wawo ungu-20 noma ngaphezulu
y-m-19-03.goal: Sebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwenani lamakhadi angu-negethivu nophawu lomkhiqizo ukuthola ukuhlanganiswa okuningana okuhlangabezana nesimo, bese unquma ukuthi ungagwema kanjani ukushiya umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu.

y-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.0: Phindaphinda izimo zokudonsa amakhadi angu-negethivu angu-1, 2, nangu-3 ngakunye bese uhlola izimpawu kuqala.

y-m-19-03.s.s1.r.b: Umkhiqizo wekhadi elingu-1 elingu-negethivu namakhadi angu-2 aphozithivu unenombolo eyodwa engu-negethivu ephindaphindiwe, ngakho ungu-negethivu.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.r.c: Umkhiqizo wamakhadi amabili angu-negethivu uba yiphozithivu kuqala, futhi ukuphindaphinda ngekhadi eliphozithivu elisele kuwugcina uyiphozithivu.
